$why: Moved out of run-agent-orchestration.sh on 2026-08-16. Same shape as lint-finding-analyst:
the current ACs and the role instructions were both computed by shell pipelines inside the
heredoc, so the remediator could be asked to extend criteria it had not been shown.
description: Adds acceptance criteria to the story a lint failure was mapped to, so the failure cannot recur.
body:
You are the story-ac-remediator. A lint gate failure was mapped to story '__STORY_ID__'.

## Finding
__FINDING__

## Current story ACs
__CURRENT_ACS__

## Agent Profile
__PROFILE__

Add 1-2 ACs to story '__STORY_ID__' that would prevent this lint failure. Output JSON only:
{"story_id":"__STORY_ID__","new_acs":["<ac text>"],"rationale":"<why>"}
